plan_notes.not_a_release: moving to {{target}} — not a release version, so no direction is checked
plan_notes.record_no_version: moving to {{target}} — the record names no comparable version ({{current}})
plan_notes.past_newest: {{current}} is past the newest release {{target}} — the pin stays; pass --ref to move it

missing_record: {{root}} records no akmon attach (no mount mode in the integration record under {{aitna}}/) — attach it with `akmon init`
init_failed: akmon update: init failed ({{code}}); see its output above
checks_failed: akmon update: `{{script}} {{flag}}` failed ({{code}}) — the update is not finished
subtree_refusal: mode 'subtree' moves with one command update must not run for you — `git subtree pull` creates commits, and commits are the owner's (D5). Run it, then realign:
package_uv_missing:
mode 'package' moves the pin with uv, and `uv` is not on PATH. With another manager, point the pin at {{target}} and install it, then run `akmon init`; with uv:
    {{command}}
package_launcher_missing: {{launcher}} does not exist — mode 'package' runs akmon from the project's own virtualenv; `uv sync` installs it
vendored_not_fetchable: mode 'vendored' copies the tree of the akmon CLI that runs init, and the recorded {{recorded}} is not a release this can fetch — realign with that version's own CLI, or pass --ref to move
vendored_uvx_missing:
mode 'vendored' copies the tree of the akmon CLI that runs init, so {{tag}} needs its own CLI, and `uvx` (uv) is not on PATH to fetch it. Run that version's init, e.g.:
    {{command}}
closing_changelog: read CHANGELOG.md after {{last}} up to {{target}}: each Breaking or Migration line there is a checklist item for this project
closing_review: review `git diff` and stage {{staged}} with the generated files that changed — the commit is the owner's (D5)
closing_bump: record the bump in this project — a `{{aitna}}/TASKS_ARCHIVE.md` line or its own changelog
closing_codex: Codex: if `.codex/hooks.json` changed, re-approve its hooks with /hooks — a changed entry runs nothing until then
